title: Space profile sections come from the one block registry
detail:
Split from PROG-E2 on 2026-11-16 (owner approval, Daniel, decision "Fix both, then fold Space profile"). The first of four folds. The hand-written Space profile catalog (lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts, fourteen rows restating what the entity-block registry already held) is deleted. lib/entity-blocks/space-profile.ts derives the same list from the registry's Space rows: label, order and function gate come from ENTITY_BLOCKS. Every importer is repointed. The block-system ratchet is lowered 5 to 4 through the gate's own --update path.

Owner rulings kept: the eleven core Space blocks are untouched; no migration; rendered output and stored layouts are byte for byte the same; nothing appears on a palette it was not on (the registry's rows and palette sets are not edited).

Three things stay local in the new module, on purpose: the list of which registry rows are profile sections; one id map (the stored section id `highlights` reads the registry row `stats`, so no stored layout is rewritten and `stats` still does not validate as a flat section id); and three descriptions (About, Highlights, Offerings) where the two catalogs had drifted, kept in the profile wording so nothing a person reads changed.

VERIFIED: goldens (lib/entity-blocks/space-profile.golden.test.ts) written and green against the old catalog first, then green against the derived list with only the import line changed; the registry, profile layout, section nav, memberships registration and updates retirement tests; lint, scoped typecheck and the contract guards through prepush; check:block-baselines at 4. NOT VERIFIED: no browser pass on a Space profile or its settings page, no Vercel build, and the postbuild budget gates (the new module makes lib/spaces/profile-modules.ts import the registry file at runtime, where it imported only types before).

Follow-ups: the renderer map in space-profile-modules.tsx is still a second map; the owner picks one line of copy for the three drifted descriptions. Still on PROG-E2: Spotlight, Layout modules, Puck.

verify.note: Fails on main: lib/entity-blocks/space-profile.ts does not exist, lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts does, and block-systems reads 5. Passes when the list loaded from the new module equals the frozen fourteen byte for byte, every section matches a live ENTITY_BLOCKS row a Space may hold (label, order, function gate), the default layouts are unchanged, no file under app, components or lib imports the old catalog, and the ratchet reads 4 or lower.
